content: {"like":["Values high-quality visual and audio experiences, especially 4K UHD and HDR; appreciates strong storytelling, character development, and historical accuracy; enjoys well-crafted screenplays and performances by acclaimed actors; looks forward to continued series or sequels; appreciates detailed demo videos and educational content."],"dislike":["Dislikes poor audio quality, lack of audio options, and low-resolution or misrepresented 4K content; is critical of misleading packaging and technical issues that degrade image quality; rejects content with weak or superficial plots, poor character development, or lack of suspension of disbelief; is annoyed by excessive noise, low edge sharpness, and marketing tactics that port low-res footage to 4K; dislikes content that feels gimmicky or not worth rewatching."]}
